description: Poly Haven "pure sky" HDRIs (ground replaced by a neutral lower hemisphere), 2K equirectangular .hdr, for scene.environment and scene.background.

files.author: Greg Zaal (Original), Jarod Guest (Sky edits)
files.notes: Sky-only version of Kloofendal 48d Partly Cloudy (ground replaced). Crisp cumulus, strong unclipped sun (the "48d" in the name is its elevation, which matches the measurement). Best default daytime sky.
files.role: afternoon: clear to partly cloudy, high sun
files.format: Radiance RGBE (32-bit_rle_rgbe). Load with THREE.RGBELoader (or HDRLoader in newer three.js) and set mapping = THREE.EquirectangularReflectionMapping.

sun.method: Estimated from the HDR pixel data (centroid of the brightest region). Poly Haven does not publish sun angles.
sun.threejs_direction_note: Unit vector toward the sun in three.js world space, with this HDR as scene.environment/background under the default equirect mapping and no environmentRotation/backgroundRotation. u = 0.5 (image centre) faces +X and u = 0.75 faces +Z. Put the DirectionalLight at direction * distance. If you rotate the sky about Y (scene.environmentRotation.y / backgroundRotation.y, r162+), rotate this vector by the same angle.

files.author: Greg Zaal (Original), Jarod Guest (Sky Edits)
files.notes: Low, warm (orange-white) unclipped sun with scattered clouds; high contrast (EV range 21). For golden-hour lighting with long shadows. Sky-only version.
files.role: golden hour: low warm sun, partly cloudy
